description: Golden vectors of residue openings, version 2 of the hop proof (CYBERSPACE_V2 sections 5.9 to 5.13, 8.4, 8.7.1, 8.8), generated by hop-residue-vectors.py from hop-residue-reference.py. A port copies this file unchanged into its fixtures and must reproduce every value.
format: Every hex string is lowercase, except inside the verifier vectors that test uppercase.
c and C are the hop's coordinates as their tags carry them, 64 hex characters; from and to give the same coordinates as x, y, z and plane.

Bases, t_base, coordinates on an axis, primes, residues, budgets B and prices A are decimal strings, whatever their size, because many exceed 2^53 and a JSON parser may not read such a number exactly. Heights, K, h_max, m, blocks, depth, nonce, indices, offsets and lengths are JSON numbers, and every one of them is below 2^53.
primes_sha256 is SHA-256 over be64(p_0) || ... || be64(p_(m-1)); residues_sha256 is SHA-256 over be64(r_0) || ... || be64(r_(m-1)); mp_sha256 is SHA-256 over the mp tag value as ASCII.
attempt_nonce_0 is G for nonce 0 under the hop's seal, whether or not it meets the price.
In checks, mp_offset is where opening i starts in the mp tag value, in characters, and siblings run from the leaf level upward.

In verifier, a tag missing from tags is missing from the event. first_failure names the first check that fails when the steps of section 5.11 run in order (form, price, then for each sample in ascending i its residue and then its path); a port that orders its checks differently must still reach expected, and may fail at a different step.

In grandfathered_v1, event_id is a stand-in, SHA-256 of an ASCII label rather than the NIP-01 hash of a signed event, because the vector tests only the list lookup of section 8.7.1 step 7, and grandfathered_v1_hops is the text of a list in the format of grandfathered-v1-hops.txt that the vector injects in place of the real one. expected is the verdict on the hop's proof; the rest of the hop is checked as for any other hop.

prover.name: golden-5.7
prover.description: The movement of section 5.7, (0, 0, 0) -> (4104, 0, 0) on plane 0, with previous_event_id equal to 32 zero bytes: the golden vector of section 5.10.

prover.name: multi-axis-earth
prover.description: A hop near Earth's center that moves on all three axes (x at h11, y at h8, z at h9) with a nonzero previous_event_id (the bytes 0x00 to 0x1f): the second hop the reference prints.

prover.name: plane-only-k-positive
prover.description: A hop that changes only the plane, from 0 to 1, so every axis is at h0 and h_max is K, which is above 0 here. previous_event_id is SHA-256 of the ASCII label 'hop-residue-vectors plane-only'.

prover.name: k-zero-axis-h6
prover.description: A hop with K = 0 and one axis at h6, the first height with a nonzero re-roll budget: A = B(6) = 1. The destination is the first point near Earth's center whose four terrain nibbles are all 0. previous_event_id is SHA-256 of the ASCII label 'hop-residue-vectors k-zero h6'.

prover.name: h0-k-zero
prover.description: A hop with every axis at h0 and K = 0, a change of plane from 1 to 0 onto the same K = 0 point: m = 8, one leaf, depth 0, A = 1, so the seal is leaf_0 and each opening carries no siblings. previous_event_id is SHA-256 of the ASCII label 'hop-residue-vectors h0 k-zero'.

prover.name: into-plane-1
prover.description: A hop that moves on x and z and crosses from plane 0 into plane 1, so K is derived with the plane bit set. previous_event_id is SHA-256 of the ASCII label 'hop-residue-vectors into plane 1'.

prover.name: h16-one-axis
prover.description: A hop at h16 on x alone, near Earth's center, large enough that every level of a port's residue engine above the trivial ones is exercised. previous_event_id is SHA-256 of the ASCII label 'hop-residue-vectors h16'.

verifier.name: other-nonce-accepted
verifier.description: The same seal with nonce 193, the first nonce above 87 that meets the price and whose mn contains a hex letter, and the openings drawn under its own G. Any nonce that meets the price is valid (section 5.10), so this is accepted. The vectors mn-uppercase and openings-under-another-G are built from it.

verifier.name: sampled-residue-flipped
verifier.description: In opening 0, the sampled residue (position 4 of block 261) has its lowest bit flipped.

verifier.name: unsampled-residue-flipped
verifier.description: In opening 0, a residue the sample does not name (position 5 of block 261) has its lowest bit flipped, so the residue check passes and the leaf no longer climbs to the seal.

verifier.name: residue-unreduced
verifier.description: In opening 0, the sampled residue is written as r + p, the same value modulo p but not reduced. It still fits in 16 hex characters.

verifier.name: mp-one-sibling-short
verifier.description: Opening 0 loses its last sibling (64 characters), so mp is 64 characters short.

verifier.name: mp-one-character-long
verifier.description: mp with one extra '0' at the end.

verifier.name: mn-one-character-short
verifier.description: mn with its first character removed (15 characters).

verifier.name: proof-uppercase
verifier.description: proof written in uppercase hex; the same value otherwise.

verifier.name: mn-uppercase
verifier.description: The accepted other-nonce vector with its mn written in uppercase hex; the same value otherwise.

verifier.name: mp-uppercase
verifier.description: mp written in uppercase hex; the same values otherwise.

verifier.name: nonce-misses-price
verifier.description: mn is nonce 0, the first nonce counting up from 0 whose G does not satisfy G x A < 2^256.

verifier.name: openings-under-another-G
verifier.description: mn is nonce 193, which meets the price, but mp holds the openings drawn under the G of nonce 87.

verifier.name: copied-to-another-previous-event-id
verifier.description: The section 5.7 hop's tags unchanged, on a hop with the same c and C whose previous_event_id is the bytes 0x00 to 0x1f.

verifier.name: fabricated-commitment
verifier.description: A list of 2856 random 61-bit values (Python random.Random seeded with the string 'hop-residue-vectors fabricated') sealed, ground to the first nonce that meets the price and opened honestly: it passes the price and fails the first residue check.

grandfathered_v1.name: version-1-listed
grandfathered_v1.description: A version 1 hop (the section 5.7 movement, its section 5.6 proof_hash in proof, no mn and no mp) whose id is on the list, with commentary after the id: its proof is accepted without recomputation, and everything else about the hop is checked as for any other hop.

grandfathered_v1.description: The same version 1 hop with a list that does not contain its id; the list carries the id only on a comment line, which names nothing. A version 1 hop that is not listed is rejected (section 5.13).
